title: Baghrir
description: Baghrir is a Morocco classic prepared with semolina flour, all-purpose flour, instant yeast, baking powder. A measured home-style version, with ingredients assigned to the cooking steps where they are used. Baghrir requires a light airy semolina batter and one-sided cooking; this is a homemade yeast version.

steps.instruction: Combine the listed ingredients in a bowl until evenly mixed; avoid overworking delicate components.
Cover the batter loosely and leave in a suitable warm, clean place for about 40 minutes to become bubbly and lightly tangy; do not refrigerate during active fermentation.
Pour small rounds of bubbly batter into a medium-hot nonstick pan; cook baghrir on ONE side only until many holes appear and the surface is dry.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
